items.title: 9.2.1 What is a Business Plan? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2.1 (PDF 209-210), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Business plan ek document (likha hua kaghaz) hai jo aap ka business idea, use kamyab banane ka tareeqa, aur apne goals (maqasid) tak pohanchne ke qadam bayan karta hai. Yeh aham details (tafseel) par sochne mein madad deta hai aur pakka karta hai ke aap karobar shuru karne ke liye tayyar hain.

blocks.prompt: Business plan banane ka pehla qadam kya hai (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Business idea tay karna (Defining the business idea).

items: Business plan: idea, kamyabi ka tareeqa aur goals tak pohanchne ke qadam.
